title: Ocean Letter Splash
hook: Every wave brings a word to me!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat of quiet after the letter cue
visualStyle: friendly polished 3D storybook ocean art, aqua and coral palette, soft rounded shapes, clean preschool character design

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: playful reef guide following splashes and movement
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: two-line splash hook that resets attention
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written ocean image lines; rhyme may travel across three or four neighboring targets before changing family
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: cue-gap-answer plus object-conditioned gesture; rotate direct, repeated, question and find forms
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 sparse marimba/ukulele; chorus wider; Round 2 stop-start with percussion dropouts
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: marimba splash answer after each target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn alphabet learning into one widening ocean dive: begin with a splash, move through reef shelter and deeper water, then rise toward the surface again so the child feels motion, scale, and wonder rather than a list of sea nouns.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: Water-motion language leads the song: splash, glide, drift, dip, rise, breathe. Quick surface hits alternate with spacious underwater images; blue, depth, shelter, ripple, and breath recur without becoming fixed tails.
semanticArc: rise toward surface light and carry the words home
